# Vendored libraries

- `lame.min.js` — [lamejs](https://github.com/zhuker/lamejs) 1.2.1 (commit 582bbba), a JavaScript port of the
  [LAME MP3 encoder](https://lame.sourceforge.io/), unmodified. LGPL-3.0. The panel uses it to turn uploaded WAV,
  AIFF or FLAC recordings into 320 kbps MP3 files in the browser before they are published.
